summary: The reader has finished an undergraduate computer science degree: asymptotic analysis, basic algorithms (divide and conquer, sorting, recurrences, schoolbook integer arithmetic), discrete mathematics, and introductory linear algebra, abstract algebra (groups, rings, fields, modular arithmetic) and probability. They know Turing machines and tapes at a basic level, but not the multitape fixed-alphabet cost model in detail, nor Fourier-analytic multiplication, FFT variants, or specialist algebra such as bilinear forms over F_2 and matrix factorizations like Bruhat.

known.name: Matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Vectors, matrices, linear maps, invertibility, bases, and triangular matrices over a field.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers modulo n, including congruence classes and cyclic groups Z/nZ.

known.name: Chinese remainder theorem
known.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli, Z/(m1 m2) is isomorphic to Z/m1 x Z/m2.

known.name: Prime numbers and coprimality
known.gloss: Primes, greatest common divisors, and coprime integers.

known.name: Groups, rings and fields
known.gloss: Basic algebraic structures, including the two-element field F_2, cyclic groups, products of groups and ring homomorphisms.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Writing integers in base 2 or base b and operating on bits, including XOR as addition in F_2.

known.name: Schoolbook and divide-and-conquer multiplication
known.gloss: The O(n^2) digit-by-digit multiplication algorithm and the Karatsuba divide-and-conquer improvement.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform
known.gloss: The O(n log n) divide-and-conquer algorithm for the discrete Fourier transform of power-of-two length, as met in an algorithms course.

known.name: Floor, ceiling, logarithms and exponents
known.gloss: Standard notation for logarithms base 2 and rounding down or up.

known.name: Recurrences and amortized cost accounting
known.gloss: Solving divide-and-conquer recurrences and summing costs per level or per call.

known.name: Sorting and permutations
known.gloss: Rearranging a list by a permutation and sorting in O(m log m) comparisons.

known.name: Norms and inequalities
known.gloss: Vector and complex norms, the triangle inequality, and bounding errors.

known.name: Rounding and floating or fixed point error
known.gloss: Approximating real numbers by finite precision values and bounding the error.

known.name: Gaussian integers and dyadic rationals
known.gloss: Complex numbers a+bi with integer a,b, and rationals with power-of-two denominators.

known.name: Multidimensional arrays and product index sets
known.gloss: Arrays indexed by tuples of coordinates and flattening them to a linear tape order.

known.name: Sums and product notation, Euler's formula
known.gloss: Sigma and product notation, and e^{i theta}=cos theta + i sin theta.

known.name: Graphs and networks
known.gloss: Vertices, edges, paths, and circuits made of gates as met in discrete mathematics.

known.name: Subsets and counting
known.gloss: Counting subsets, binomial coefficients, and indicator vectors of subsets.

known.name: Basic probability and combinatorial bounds
known.gloss: Pigeonhole and simple counting arguments used to bound exceptional sets.
